audience: small teams that keep their contacts, groups and CRM activities in GreenRope

useCases.title: Find a contact and the groups they belong to
useCases.text: Find a contact by email, name or id. Then list the groups that this contact belongs to.

useCases.title: Browse groups and their contacts
useCases.text: List the contact groups, or one group by id or name. Then list the contacts that belong to that group.

useCases.title: Review CRM calls, tasks and notes for a period
useCases.text: Check the CRM activity types first. Then list the activities by contact, group, type or date range.

useCases.title: Add new leads to a group
useCases.text: Create up to 50 contacts by email. Then add them to a group by its id or name. This changes the group membership.

useCases.title: Record a call note against a contact
useCases.text: Check the CRM activity types first. Then record one note or task against a contact. The label must match a type from the account.
